head_unit_logs.note: All retained rows have producer level E. 22078 are CarPlay sampler observations; producer severity alone is not evidence of a failure.

scope.method: All retained pages inventoried through GET requests, IDs deduplicated, exception patterns mapped to current implementation, synthetic regressions and independent review.
scope.coverage_limit: Retained history only; this does not reconstruct pruned logs or establish a physical device fault.

findings.issue: Reset could replace processing while the old owner was still writing.
findings.fix: Serialize claim commit/owner registration, resets and outcome transactions; register before hardware discovery; abort waits complete owner and refuses replacement on timeout.

findings.issue: HTTP messages, exception tracebacks and URL objects could expose webhook path credentials.
findings.fix: Redact webhook paths before storage and after exception formatting for both stdout renderers; redact historical API log responses without rewriting source rows.

findings.issue: Head-unit log consumption deleted remote capture files before a durable host import.
findings.fix: Read without deletion, verify capture process exited and complete transfer marker, commit host storage before acknowledgement/rearm; retain failed captures for retry.

findings.issue: Rollback expired ORM state and could turn SQLite contention into MissingGreenlet or PendingRollbackError.
findings.fix: Refresh stage retry state asynchronously, replay inferred timeline, and inspect probe evidence passively before rollback.

findings.issue: Event mirror storage could wait beyond its deadline, exceed SQLite bind limits, or partially commit before retention failed.
findings.fix: Short writer waits and bounded transaction retries, executemany, SQL retention subquery, atomic insertion/pruning, and connection timeout restoration.

findings.issue: Unit-log imports awaited one SQL INSERT per line and background task failures were unobserved.
findings.fix: 250-row executemany batches, atomic retention, bounded per-address work, queued arrival preservation, and sanitized exception collection.

measurement.note: SQL-call reduction, not a production latency measurement.

findings.issue: An unfinished event mirror could silently block future activity syncs.
findings.fix: Expose active phase, age and skipped-attempt health; Backup shows cleanup waiting without promising immediate retry.
findings.limit: Fresh post-deployment sync completed twice during the online window, with new events, no mirror error and no skipped attempts. A retained historical sequence gap remains reported.

findings.issue: Journey date API had no page controls and selection could outlive visible rows.
findings.fix: Camera-local calendar range/presets with URL state, invalid-range errors, filtered empty recovery, safe page parsing and selection pruning.

findings.issue: Backup hid older bundles and lost independent content after status failure.
findings.fix: Bookmarkable bundle pagination, stale status explanation, retained data access and safe action availability.

findings.issue: Malformed URL pages/booleans/IDs silently failed or changed filter meaning.
findings.fix: Normalize supported list pagination/filter inputs across library, logs, queue and diagnostics; preserve browser history and show accurate empty-state meaning.

findings.issue: Equal-count map results at different locations did not refit; idle system alerts pointed to unrelated queue state.
findings.fix: Fit changed geographic bounds and route warnings to the actual diagnostic, recording or backup page.

findings.issue: Simultaneous log entries had no deterministic pagination tiebreaker.
findings.fix: Order by timestamp and row ID; expose available critical/debug/verbose filters.

findings.issue: Awake-unit recorder inactivity was described as lost footage without ignition or expected-recording evidence.
findings.fix: Describe measured inactivity and its evidence limits; show Recorder check needs review. Preserve supported per-camera/card warnings and notification behavior.

findings.issue: A lock during implicit flush in a stage-marker commit invalidated the ORM session; retrying commit then masked the original cause with PendingRollbackError.
findings.fix: Allow the retry helper to refuse retries on inactive sessions and propagate the exact original lock error to the owning rollback/requeue path. Do not discard pending writes in the helper.
findings.validation: Real SQLite competing-writer regression plus 59 targeted tests passed; stored metadata and counters remain unchanged after failed flush.
